messages.text: 'Pietersen will add spark' as he begins England white-ball coaching role

metadata.summary: Kevin Pietersen is “buzzing” to be back with the England set-up, having joined the white-ball coaching staff for the series against Sri Lanka, according to interim head coach Marcus Trescothick.
metadata.content: Kevin Pietersen 'buzzing' at England white-ball coaching role as specialist mentor, says Marcus Trescothick | Cricket News | Sky Sports Skip to content Kevin Pietersen 'buzzing' at England white-ball coaching role as specialist mentor, says Marcus Trescothick Kevin Pietersen "buzzing" for England role and will add "a little more spark" to white-ball sides, says batting coach Marcus Trescothick; watch the first T20I against Sri Lanka in Southampton, live on Sky Sports Cricket from 6pm, Tuesday (first ball 6.30pm) Monday 14 September 2026 06:08, UK Image: Kevin Pietersen has been appointed as a ‘specialist mentor’ to England’s white-ball teams Kevin Pietersen is “buzzing” to be back with the England set-up, having joined the white-ball coaching staff for the series against Sri Lanka, according to interim head coach Marcus Trescothick. Pietersen will serve as a specialist mentor through to the 2027 Cricket World Cup in Africa next year. He will link up with the squad this week ahead of England's first T20I against Sri Lanka on Tuesday, live on Sky Sports Cricket from 6pm, with the first ball at 6.30pm. Trescothick and Pietersen were Ashes-winning team-mates during England's famous 2005 triumph, giving the former first-hand experience of the qualities and talents the latter can bring to the current team.
